base: Top-down photo, phone held directly above, of a compact 60% mechanical keyboard (no brand, no legends printed on keys) with a matte grey aluminium case, lying on a dark wooden desk. Off-white blank keycaps, except: one red keycap at the top-left (Esc position), one long dark-grey spacebar, one mint-green Enter key. A round brass volume knob sits on the top-right corner of the case. Two black hex screws are visible on the top edge of the case. Plenty of empty desk around the keyboard.
